name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The '02' is the chapter ID (valid domain ID 01-30), not an address residue (function lives at 0x206c5). 'post_action' accurately reflects its role as the per-chapter turn-cycle post-action handler dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_post_action_handler_table[1].
purpose: Chapter 2 turn-cycle post-action handler: runs the default battle-end check, then forces game-over only if every one of the 6 key NPCs at runtime_char[5..10] is dead.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_check_battle_end_condition() (default win/lose check). Then loops i=5..10 over data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (stride RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE=0x50): if any slot's flags byte (offset +5) has bit0 (CHARFLAG_DEAD) clear, i.e. that NPC is still alive, it returns immediately leaving the default flag intact. Only if all six slots 5..10 are dead does it set data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code (0x53ECC) = 1 (game over). event_arg is the Watcom __CHK-prologue stack artifact and is unused.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Dispatched cdecl argument, unused by the body. All dispatch sites push exactly one cdecl arg + ADD ESP,4: turn-phase callers (fd2_npc_turn_phase_team1 / fd2_enemy_turn_phase_team0 / fd2_game_main_loop) push the active loop char_idx (ESI); fd2_tick_status_effects_and_show_messages pushes literal 0. The function ignores the value regardless; it appears in the signature only because the Watcom __CHK prologue reads a stack slot.
params.reason: Accurate generic name for an unused dispatched argument; no address residue; matches the convention shared by every chapter post-action handler in this file.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: may set data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code = 1 (game over) when all 6 key NPCs are dead; otherwise leaves the flag as set by fd2_check_battle_end_condition.

reads_globals: data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (0x53A45) - base of runtime character array; reads flags byte at +5 of slots 5..10
writes_globals: data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code (0x53ECC) - set to 1 (game over) only if every NPC in slots 5..10 is dead
notes: Verified against disassembly: PUSH 0x8 / CALL __CHK prologue; CALL fd2_check_battle_end_condition (0x205be); loop i=5..10 (CMP EDX,0xb / JGE), stride i*0x50 (SHL*2 + LEA + SHL*4), TEST byte [+5],0x1; MOV dword [0x53ecc],0x1 only after loop completes. Dispatch table @ 0x51B19 entry [1] = 0x000206c5 confirmed via read_memory. Constants RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE=0x50 and CHARFLAG_DEAD=0x01 confirmed in consts.h. The plate's 'pushes 1 cdecl arg (the active char_idx) then ADD ESP,4' is verified correct as the dispatch convention (all sites: 1 cdecl arg + ADD ESP,4); 'active char_idx' describes the dominant turn-phase callers, with fd2_tick_status_effects pushing literal 0 instead -- body ignores either way, so plate is not in error and was left unchanged. Source comment block (chpost.c lines 11-25) is already precise/ASCII; kept as-is.
